item:
Firmware proven: `kerf firmware-check

` compiles every generated Nano / PCA9685 sketch with arduino-cli (arduino:avr core + library index from downloads.arduino.cc, pinned versions, installed by setup.sh) and runs the Nano build in simavr (apt), recording the servo pulse widths on every signal pin during centre + sweep and checking them against the joint ranges and PULSE_LIMITS; Pi scripts byte-compile and run against a stub GPIO that records the same; part of `kerf build` when a project has firmware; tests incl. a deliberately broken sketch that must FAIL (Wokwi rejected: its CLI needs a paid CI token)
